description.en: A per-barn dairy management layer for the Realistic Farming ecosystem: herd health, milk quality, spoilage timing, collection scheduling and dairy contracts, all riding the shared in-game economic clock (Time Guard). It reads the base game herd values in standard mode and switches to a per-animal genetics calculation when Ritter's Realistic Livestock is present, and it degrades gracefully when a companion mod is absent.
